API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAdmin Audit LogsStart Audit Report Entry CSV Export
Start Audit Report Entry CSV Export
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/auditlogEntryReport

Creates an audit log report for the specified time period and saves it as a CSV file. The report includes audit information for every call made to the cloud service API during the specified time period. Creating a new audit log report overwrites a previously-generated report.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Audit log entry request, which includes the following values:

startTime: The timestamp, in epoch, of the admin's last login.
endTime: The timestamp, in epoch, of the admin's last logout.
actionTypes: The action performed by the admin in the Zscaler Admin Portal (i.e., Admin UI) or API. .
category: The location in the Zscaler Admin Portal (i.e., Admin UI) where the actionType was performed. .
subcategories: The area within a category where the actionType was performed. .
actionResult: The outcome (i.e., Failure or Success) of an actionType.
actionInterface: The interface (i.e., Admin UI or API) where the actionType was performed.
clientIP: The source IP address for the admin.
adminName: The admin's login ID.
startTime
int64

Start time for audit log entry

endTime
int64

End time for audit log entry

page
int32
pageSize
int32
actionTypes
string[]

Action type for audit log entry

Possible values: [SIGN_IN, SIGN_OUT, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, PATCH, AUDIT_OPERATION, ACTIVATE, FORCED_ACTIVATE, IMPORT, REPORT, DOWNLOAD]

category
string

Category for audit log entry

subcategories
string[]

Subcategories for audit log entry

actionResult
string

Result for audit log entry

actionInterface
string

Interface for audit log entry

objectName
string

Object name for audit log entry

clientIP
string

Client IP for audit log entry

adminName
string

Admin name for audit log entry

targetOrgId
int32
traceId
string

A trace ID is generated and logged for transactions associated with ZIA API requests made via . The trace ID helps admins correlate API transactions with the OneAPI platform and you can use the trace ID for debugging purposes.

Responses
​
204

Successful Operation
